item.title: Dr. Larry J. Moray
item.dc:creator: New Patient Group
item.content:encoded:
Dr. Larry J. Moray brings a unique perspective to his practice. His life philosophy has been to enjoy the richness of life’s many experiences, and this permeates all his endeavors. Dr. Moray moved to Chapel Hill in 1979, entering a Ph.D. program in neurobiology.
He later completed dental training at the University of North Carolina (UNC) School of Dentistry and spent one year in a hospital dental residency in Hampton, Virginia. Dr. Moray taught at the VCU/MCV School of Dentistry and managed the hospital dental clinic at MCV Hospitals in Richmond, Virginia from 1991 to 1994.
Following graduation from his orthodontic residency at UNC in 1997, Dr. Moray opened our first office at Preston Corners. MyOrthodontist has grown tremendously under his guidance and our team of dental professionals now serves 14 communities throughout North Carolina.

item.title: Dr. Gisela Borget
item.dc:creator: New Patient Group
item.content:encoded:
Dr. Gisela Borget was born in Jalisco, Mexico. She was raised in Utah and attended the University of Utah for her undergraduate studies and went on to receive her D.D.S. from the UNC School of Dentistry in Chapel Hill.
After dental school, Dr. Borget completed an orthodontic residency and earned her Master of Science degree at the University of Iowa. Dr. Borget is happily married and enjoys her three children: two girls and a boy.
When not practicing orthodontics, she enjoys reading, running, and spending time with her family and friends. Dr. Borget speaks Spanish fluently and is very excited to work with families in the Burgaw area!

item.title: Dr. Elizabeth Ottey
item.dc:creator: New Patient Group
item.content:encoded:
Dr. Elizabeth Marie Alston Ottey was born and raised in Burlington, North Carolina. She attended and graduated from the University of North Carolina at Charlotte with a Bachelor of Science Degree and a Minor in Women Studies in 2010. In 2013, she received her Master of Health Science from Meharry Medical College. In 2017, Dr. Ottey graduated from Meharry receiving the distinguished honor of graduating at the top of her class. In spring 2020, Dr. Ottey received her Master’s in Biomedical Science and a Specialist Certificate in Orthodontics from the University of Maryland.
Dr. Ottey is very dedicated to giving back to the community especially in helping young people. In 2019, Dr. Ottey was honored by Unified Efforts for her mentoring of young people by being named Baltimore’s Shining Star.
In May 2020, Dr. Ottey was recognized for her dedication to the University of Maryland Baltimore’s core values by winning the 2020 Presidential Core Values Award for Diversity. Dr. Ottey is a member of the American Association of Orthodontist and American Dental Association. Dr. Ottey is board certified by the American Board of Orthodontics Dr. Ottey is married to Orbie E. Ottey, DDS and they have one dog, Scotch. In her leisure time, Dr. Ottey enjoys singing, working with, and mentoring young people. She particularly loves entertaining and spending time with her family and friends.

item.title: Dr. Hunter Neill
item.dc:creator: New Patient Group
item.content:encoded:
Dr. Neill is a native of Montgomery, Alabama. He earned his Bachelor of Science Degree with highest honors from the University of Alabama at Birmingham and later went on to receive his Doctor of Dental Medicine Degree where he finished in the top of his class. He completed his orthodontic residency at the University of Colorado Denver earning both a Certificate in Orthodontics as well as a Master of Science Degree.
Dr. Neill spent his first few years after training as an associate working in the Philadelphia area. He attends yearly continuing education courses at the Orthodontic National Convention and is a member of the American Association of Orthodontists, American Dental Association, Southern Association of Orthodontics, as well as a number of regional and local professional organizations.
Dr. Neill was recently married and is moving to North Carolina to build a family and practice closer to home. He cherishes the time he is able to spend with his family and friends as well as numerous outdoor activities including snow skiing, waterskiing, hiking, climbing, and whitewater rafting.
Dr. Neill is excited about being in Wake Forest and can’t wait to meet all of you!

item.title: Dr. Angela Kang
item.dc:creator: New Patient Group
item.content:encoded:
Originally from Michigan, Dr. Kang attended the prestigious University of Michigan (Go Blue!) to study Neuroscience. She then attended and graduated at the top of her class from the University of Pittsburgh School of Dental Medicine. During her studies, she was inducted into the prestigious Omicron Kappa Omicron Upsilon (OKU) National Dental Honor Society for her academic achievements. She then completed her orthodontic training at St. Louis University, where she had in-depth training in traditional and contemporary orthodontic treatments and appliances.
When Dr. Kang is not creating beautiful smiles for her patients, she enjoys spending time with her family, exploring new cuisines and restaurants, and live comedy shows. Her new favorite cuisine is Ethiopian, and you should try it too!
We believe Dr. Kang’s knowledge and passion for orthodontics make her an amazing member of our team and will help us provide the best personalized orthodontic care for you.

item.title: Dr. Mayté Accornero
item.dc:creator: New Patient Group
item.content:encoded:
Dr. Mayté Accornero received her DMD Dental Degree from the University of Puerto Rico in 2004. After dental school, she completed a general practice residency program in Brooklyn, NY where she served as Chief Resident. She then moved to Apex, NC where she practiced general dentistry. After 14 years as a general dentist, Dr. Accornero (“Dr. A”) moved to New York to complete an orthodontic residency program at the NYU Langone Medical Center in Brooklyn, NY. During her residency, she served as Chief Resident and received many accolades including the Program Director’s Award for her contribution toward the academic, educational, and administrative processes in the program.
Dr. Accornero is an active member of the American Association of Orthodontists (AAO), American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry (AAPD), Southern Association of Orthodontists (SAO), and the American Dental Association (ADA). Dr. Accornero is happy to return home to North Carolina after two years away for orthodontic training. When not practicing orthodontics, she enjoys music, reading, going to the beach, and spending time with her husband, family and friends. Dr. Accornero speaks Spanish fluently and is very excited to work with families in the Cary area and cannot wait to meet you all!

item.title: Dr. Spencer Marsh
item.dc:creator: New Patient Group
item.content:encoded:
Originally from Rochester NY, Dr. Spencer Marsh earned both his undergraduate and dental degree in biology from the University of Buffalo (Go Bills!). He then decided to leave the cold of upstate NY and completed his master’s in Orthodontics at the University of Texas at San Antonio where he graduated as the chief resident. While earning his master’s, his thesis was published in the International Journal of Dental Materials
Outside of the office Dr. Marsh enjoys spending time with friends and his wife, Gina. He’s an Eagle Scout and loves the outdoors whether it’s hiking, camping, or boating.

item.title: Dr. Donna Nichols
item.dc:creator: New Patient Group
item.content:encoded:
Dr. Donna Nichols received her training in Orthodontics at the Howard University College of Dentistry in Washington, DC. However, North Carolina has always been where her heart lives.
Dr. Nichols was practically raised on NC State University's campus, where both parents are employed. Despite efforts to bring her into the Wolfpack, she became a double Tar Heel, attending dental school and college at UNC-Chapel Hill. Dr. Nichols also attended UNC- Greensboro's post-baccalaureate program.
She is passionate about Orthodontics because of the external and internal transformative results, the patient relationships, and the puzzle-like problem-solving that goes into planning for that fantastic final result.
She loves spending time with friends and family, mainly when it includes travel, singing, and eating great food. She's a foodie and loves trying new things. She's also hoping the Alamance County YMCA's adult league will reconvene soon so she can rejoin the team. She's honored to serve and give back to the people of North Carolina as an Orthodontist.

item.dc:creator: New Patient Group
item.content:encoded:
Dr. Ruth attended the University of North Carolina at Charlotte for his undergrad, earning a BA in chemistry with a minor in biology. It was during this time that he developed a love for applied sciences and helping people achieve overall health.
Dr. Ruth moved to Richmond upon graduation and joined the dental program at Virginia Commonwealth University School of Dentistry.
Following dental school, he began working towards his orthodontic certification at Saint Louis University Center for Advanced Dental Education in Missouri. Dr. Ruth is passionate about giving back to the community.
He has generously donated his time over the years, providing dental care for at-risk youth and families who lack finances for routine dental care.

item.title: Dr. Renate Soltmann
item.dc:creator: New Patient Group
item.content:encoded:
Dr. Renate Soltmann brings her extensive experience to the team at MyOrthodontist. She sees patients out of the practice’s Chapel Hill, North Carolina, location.
Dr. Soltmann, a native of Germany, has lived in the Triangle area since 1979. After graduating with degrees in chemistry and microbiology, she received her DDS degree from the UNC School of Dentistry.
Upon completion of her orthodontic residency from the UNC School of Dentistry, she joined the faculty at UNC Department of Orthodontics for two years. She has been treating patients in Raleigh since 1991 in her own private practice.
Concurrently, Dr. Soltmann has also been serving as adjunct faculty in the UNC Department of Orthodontics, where her main focus is the orthodontic treatment and rehabilitation of patients with cleft lip and palate.
Dr. Soltmann is an award-winning quilter. When she doesn’t sit at her sewing machine, she loves to read and participate in citizen science projects. She has two adult sons, both of whom inherited her interest in science and are aerospace engineers. Dr. Soltmann is excited about being in Roanoke Rapids and Greensboro and is looking forward to meeting everyone.

item.title: Dr. Imelda Kwakye-Ackah
item.dc:creator: New Patient Group
item.content:encoded:
Dr. Imelda Kwakye-Ackah moved to the United States from Ghana at age 19 to pursue her University education. Dr. Imelda began her professional journey, completing her BS in Chemical Engineering (with a Minor in Economics) at UMBC in 2012. During graduate training at Duke University's Engineering Management program, she pursued orthodontic treatment in our Chapel Hill office, where she met long-time Durham Orthodontist and Orthodontic educator Dr. Richard Beane, who opened the world of dentistry and specifically Orthodontics to Dr. Imelda.
Orthodontics for Dr. Imelda, like it is for so many engineers, allowed her to combine her love of engineering with her love of people and service. As such, she made a professional pivot and completed dental school at Howard University College of Dentistry and Orthodontic Training at Tufts University.
Beyond her academic pursuits, Dr. Imelda's primary focus is on creating beautiful smiles and enhancing her patients' quality of life through her work in orthodontics. Outside of her professional commitments, she finds joy in sports, beauty, window shopping, and spending cherished moments with her family, including her husband and three children. Her commitment to continuous learning and self-improvement is evident in her active participation in orthodontic conferences and meetings, allowing her to stay current with the latest advancements in her field.

item.title: Dr. Thomas Hoopes
item.dc:creator: New Patient Group
item.content:encoded: Dr. Hoopes was born and raised in the Boston area. He moved to Philadelphia to study mechanical engineering at the University of Pennsylvania during which he also studied abroad at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology. He received his Doctor of Dental Surgery degree from Columbia University while serving as class president. Dr. Hoopes enthusiastically embraced the opportunity to leave the cold winters of the Northeast and moved to the Triangle to complete his specialty training in orthodontics at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. While attending UNC, he completed his Master's thesis on bone remodeling that occurs when using mini-implants during orthodontic treatment. Dr. Hoopes is married to Dr. Cher Hoopes, an endodontist in the Triangle, whom he met in dental school. Outside of orthodontics, Dr. Hoopes loves exploring the beautiful hiking trails in North Carolina with his wife and their dog, Sawyer. He also enjoys cooking, watching Formula 1 racing, and rooting for his Boston sports teams.

item.title: Dr. Daniel Levy
item.dc:creator: New Patient Group
item.content:encoded:
Dr. Daniel Levy is a board-certified Orthodontist who worked in academia for almost 20 years and trained over 40 orthodontic residents in the United States. Dr. Levy has been a member of the MyOrthodontist family since he arrived in North Carolina. He earned his dental degree and Master of Science in Pediatric Dentistry in Venezuela. Dr Levy also obtained a Master's in Dental Sciences and a Certificate in Orthodontics from the University of Puerto Rico, followed by specialized training in managing cleft lip and palate patients.
He is actively involved in publications and research related to orthodontics, pediatric dentistry, cleft lip and palate diagnosis, and management. He has also lectured at national and international meetings, focusing on these same dental and medical conditions.
Amara is his wife and colleague. They have two wonderful boys, Marcus and Danny. In their spare time, they love to travel, spend time with family and friends, and enjoy soccer games.

item.dc:creator: New Patient Group
item.content:encoded:
Dr. Nathaly Lemoine was born in the Dominican Republic and moved to Charlotte, North Carolina, where she spent her formative years. Her academic journey began at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, where she earned a Bachelor of Science in Chemistry.
Dr. Lemoine continued her education at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, where she received her Doctor of Dental Surgery (DDS) degree. Seeking to specialize further, she pursued an orthodontic residency at Texas A&M University's Baylor College of Dentistry in Dallas, Texas.
In addition to her professional pursuits, Dr. Lemoine maintains a well-rounded lifestyle. She values time spent with her Doberman, Xena, and enjoys engaging in board games with friends. On Sundays, she follows Formula 1 racing, and she also finds relaxation and inspiration in hiking the picturesque mountains of North Carolina.

item.title: Dr. Louis Kubala
item.dc:creator: New Patient Group
item.content:encoded:
Dr. Kubala, a South Carolina native, has been practicing orthodontics for 19 years, following six years in general dentistry. His dental journey began in the U.S. Army, where he was first stationed at Fort Campbell, KY, before serving in various locations worldwide.
Dr. Kubala later pursued specialized orthodontic training in sunny Jacksonville, FL. His training, combined with years of hands-on experience, allows him to create personalized treatment plans that improve both function and aesthetics. With a strong background in general dentistry and orthodontics, Dr. Kubala is well-equipped to help children, teenagers, and adults achieve healthy, confident smiles. He takes the time to educate his patients, ensuring they feel comfortable and informed throughout their treatment.
Outside of work, Dr. Kubala is a devoted husband and proud father of four. He values the opportunity to serve the community of Eastern North Carolina and is passionate about helping patients of all ages achieve beautiful, lasting smiles.

item.title: Dr. Chris Devantier
item.dc:creator: New Patient Group
item.content:encoded:
Dr. Chris Devantier was born in Denmark and raised in southern Utah. He earned his undergraduate degree from Brigham Young University in Provo, then went on to graduate cum laude from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas School of Dental Medicine. He completed his orthodontic residency in Jacksonville, Florida, where he received advanced training in the latest orthodontic techniques and technologies.
Dr. Devantier is a member of the American Association of Orthodontists (AAO) and is committed to staying current with the most effective and innovative treatments in orthodontic care.
Outside of work, he enjoys spending time with his wife and their three young children. He loves being outside and especially enjoys hiking, camping, and fishing.

item.title: Dr. Jackie Massouda
item.dc:creator: chuck
item.content:encoded:
Originally from the beautiful mountain regions of Utah and Colorado, Dr. Massouda grew up with a strong love for family, community, and the outdoors. She earned her undergraduate degrees in Sociology and Spanish from the University of Louisville, where she discovered her passion for the connection between oral health and overall well-being.
She went on to receive her dental degree from the University of Kentucky through the U.S. Army Health Professions Scholarship Program, using her Spanish fluency to serve Hispanic and underserved rural communities throughout Kentucky.
Dr. Massouda completed an Advanced Education in General Dentistry (AEGD) residency at Joint Base Lewis-McChord in Washington before serving four years in Germany, where working alongside an orthodontist sparked her passion for orthodontics.
After her military service, she earned her orthodontic certificate from UNC-Chapel Hill, focusing on family-centered, interdisciplinary care and researching dog-assisted therapy for pediatric dental patients. Outside the office, she enjoys hiking and biking with her family, training her miniature schnauzer, Rocco, and exploring international cuisines. She is passionate about creating healthy, confident smiles.

item.title: Dr. Bethany Doolittle
item.dc:creator: chuck
item.content:encoded:
Dr. Bethany Doolittle grew up in the suburbs of Minneapolis and St. Paul, Minnesota. She attended the University of Iowa for her undergraduate studies, where she also played collegiate basketball.
Following graduation, she spent two years playing professional basketball overseas in France and Switzerland before returning to pursue her further education.
Dr. Doolittle went on to earn her Master of Biomedical Sciences degree from Midwestern University in Illinois and later returned to the University of Iowa to complete her Doctor of Dental Surgery (DDS) degree. She then continued her training at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, where she completed her orthodontic residency.
Outside the office, Dr. Doolittle enjoys traveling, trying new foods (whether cooking at home or exploring new restaurants), watching and playing sports, and spending time outdoors.
